name: Emilio Belmont
source:
A chamberlain.
A servant that waits on [url=/c54024]Cain[/url] and the protagonist.
He has a composed and gentle personality and is loved by everyone.
He often listens to the protagonist's problems and gives advice.

(CV.松 茸夫)
